about_the_game:
Embark on a vibrant, story-rich adventure, blending elements of classic 3D platformers and modern action-RPGs.

Journey through a broken world as Ryn and join her quest to unravel an intricate web of mysteries surrounding the planet's collapse. Only by mending the broken bonds of her past can she hope to restore the future.

On your search for answers, traverse a seamless open world filled with vibrant meadows, treacherous mountains, serene forests and thundering canyons. Discover ominous ruins of a lost civilization, holding remnants of their ancient technology, as well as traces of your missing memories.

No hero stands alone. Your loyal, cat-sized dragon sidekick isn't just adorable; he's your conduit to incredible power. Feed his hunger for dark energy by defeating foes, unlocking ever-growing magical abilities that will grant you access to previously unreachable areas.

His ancient lineage holds many secrets, and his role may yet prove pivotal to the fate of all.

New challenges lurk around every corner: Conquer strategic boss battles by exploiting the environment and your agile movements. Navigate tricky platforming sections with fluid controls and unique abilities. Seek out cheeky spirits throughout the world and overcome their trials and puzzles. 

With every test of skill, unlock powerful new abilities to expand your growing arsenal.

You awaken as Ryn, a young woman with no memory, thrust into a strange land. Accompanied by an enigmatic girl holding the keys to your past, you attempt to forge a new life in a mysterious village. But just as peace seems within reach, old wounds reopen, and a hidden battle threatens to consume everything.

Fading Skies weaves a heartfelt, character-driven tale of self-discovery, human nature and a world facing collapse. As Ryn, you'll uncover a past veiled in mystery, connected to a cast of memorable and enigmatic characters.

Each revelation pulls you deeper into an emotional narrative, where healing what's broken is the key to both past and future. But can you truly trust those closest to you, or are they part of the looming catastrophe?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 VRAM 2GB or AMD Radeon R9 270X VRAM 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

short_description: Explore a vibrant fantasy universe in this action-adventure full of mystery, memorable characters, and heartfelt narrative. Unlock the powerful abilities of Ryn and her cat-sized dragon companion, as you dash and fly through a broken world to confront the shadows of a forgotten past.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
